source.code:
/-- A type `M` is a commutative “monoid with zero” if it is a commutative monoid with zero
element, and `0` is left and right absorbing. -/
class CommMonoidWithZero (M₀ : Type*) extends CommMonoid M₀, MonoidWithZero M₀
